meta.tagline: Read the Sea. Find Your Moment.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Sniper Fishing
onboarding.subtitle: Choose your language. You can change it anytime in Settings.
onboarding.note: Your choice is saved on this device. Browser detection never overrides your choice.

score.title: Fishing suitability
score.noWindow: No clearly favorable window in this period
score.fWindIdeal: Wind {v} is in the preferred range for this method
score.fWindModerate: Wind {v} is workable but less ideal
score.fWindHigh: Wind {v} is above the comfortable range for this method
score.fGustsHigh: Gusts {v} reduce control and increase risk
score.fWaveHigh: Wave height {v} makes casting or stability difficult
score.fSwellHigh: Swell {v} reduces stability and casting distance
score.fSwellPeriodGood: Swell period {v} gives more time between waves
score.fRainLight: Light rain expected — feasible with care
score.fRainHeavy: Heavy rain expected — poor comfort and visibility
score.fDlDawn: Dawn light — often a productive period
score.fDlDusk: Dusk light — often a productive period
score.fDlNight: Night — reduced visibility, higher safety attention
score.fStOk: Sea temperature {v} is within the preferred band
score.fStOut: Sea temperature {v} is outside the preferred band
score.fTideMoving: Tide is moving — can help stir up feeding
score.fDataMissing: Some data are missing at this time — the score is penalized, not assumed

safety.title: Safety assessment
safety.doNotGo: Do not go out. Conditions are not safe for this session.
safety.cautionMsg: Go with extra caution. Re-check conditions right before you leave.
safety.favorableMsg: Conditions look acceptable for this method. Verify on site.
safety.insufficientMsg: Not enough reliable data to assess this session safely.
safety.aWindCaution: Wind {v} is near/above the caution threshold for {method} ({lim})
safety.aWindUnfavorable: Wind {v} exceeds the safe threshold for {method} ({lim})
safety.aWindDangerous: Very high wind {v} ({lim}) — serious risk of exposure
safety.aWaveCaution: Wave height {v} is above the caution level ({lim})
safety.aWaveUnfavorable: Wave height {v} exceeds the safe level ({lim})
safety.aSwellCaution: Swell {v} is high for this method ({lim})
safety.aNight: Night session — plan lighting and extra caution
safety.aKayakWind: For kayak fishing, wind {v} already limits safety ({lim})
safety.aOfficialWarning: Official marine/weather warning in force for the area
safety.appGenerated: App-generated assessment based on configurable thresholds — not an official forecast
safety.disclaimer: Forecasts are uncertain. This app is not a navigation or emergency system and does not replace local authorities, maritime safety instructions, nautical charts, or professional judgment.

spots.privacy: Your spots are stored on this device only. They are never shared or published.

planner.noMissing: All major data sources responded for this session.

logbook.empty: No sessions yet. Log your first fishing session.
logbook.deleteConfirm: Delete this session and its catches?
logbook.insufficientSamples: Too few records to compare fairly

settings.title: Settings
settings.clearConfirm: This deletes your spots, sessions and settings on this device. Export your data first?
settings.importAllError: Import failed: the file does not contain valid app data
settings.storageNote: Guest mode: everything is stored locally in your browser (IndexedDB). Nothing is sent to a server unless you sign in with an account.
settings.accountNotConfigured: Cloud sync is not configured on this deployment. Sign-in is available only when Supabase environment variables are set.
settings.syncFailed: Sync failed — your local data is safe
settings.authError: Authentication failed. Check email and password.
settings.attribution: Weather & marine data: Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0, non-commercial, <10k calls/day). Map tiles & data: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Reverse geocoding: BigDataCloud free client-side API.
settings.scoreDisclaimer: The suitability score is a configurable heuristic, not a scientifically validated model. It never guarantees a catch.
settings.tideDisclaimer: No authoritative local tide table is integrated. Open-Meteo sea-level values are model estimates (~8 km resolution), not a nautical almanac.
